basic_info.description: Tucked away on a quiet tree-lined street, this full-floor Edwardian condo combines timeless charm with modern updates in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Part of a lovely two-unit building, it offers a warm, flexible layout that's perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. With two or three well proportioned bedrooms depending on needs, the home provides plenty of space to stretch out. The home offers versatility, ideal for guests, a home office, or a nursery. At the center of the home, a comfortable living room flows into a tastefully remodeled kitchen, where natural light pours through. The home retains its classic Edwardian details, balanced by thoughtful modern touches throughout.    Additional highlights include garage parking, extra storage, and in building laundry. With a near-perfect Walk Score of 98 and a Bike Score of 93, you're just moments from the Marina's best cafes, restaurants, boutiques, and parks. Truly city living at its finest.
